semiconductor_relevance: High — Reiwa Materials specializes in fluorinated solvents and performance materials for electronic products, making it relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Reiwa Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the sale and development of fluorinated solvents and performance materials tailored for electronic devices and testing equipment. Established in 2022 in Japan, the company emphasizes quality control and stable supply, serving the semiconductor sector with a commitment to innovation and customer collaboration.
capabilities: Research and development of specialty chemicals
technical_expertise: Quality control processes in semiconductor materials

regional_presence.Japan: Reiwa Materials is located in Aichi Prefecture and sells approximately 200 tons of fluorinated solvents annually within Japan.
